\section{Overview}

Declarations of the Lean module \texttt{TCSlib.Complexity.SpaceComplexity.SpaceClasses}.

\section{Declarations}

\begin{definition}[Polynomial space languages]
\lean{Complexity.PSPACE}
\label{Complexity.PSPACE}
\leanok
\uses{Complexity.SPACE}
The class $\mathrm{PSPACE}$ consists of all languages over the Boolean alphabet that are
decidable using space at most $n^c+1$ for some natural number $c$, where $n$ is the
input length.
\end{definition}

\begin{definition}[Nondeterministic polynomial space languages]
\lean{Complexity.NPSPACE}
\label{Complexity.NPSPACE}
\leanok
\uses{Complexity.NSPACE}
The class $\mathrm{NPSPACE}$ consists of all languages over the Boolean alphabet that
are decidable nondeterministically using space at most $n^c+1$ for some natural number
$c$, where $n$ is the input length.
\end{definition}

\begin{definition}[Nondeterministic logarithmic space]
\lean{Complexity.NL}
\statementsource{Vad12}{pdf-bf2ce5422088-p123-b002}
\label{Complexity.NL}
\leanok
\uses{Complexity.NSPACE, Complexity.logSpace}
The class $\mathrm{NL}$ consists of all languages over the Boolean alphabet decidable
nondeterministically using logarithmic space.
\end{definition}

\begin{definition}[Complement of nondeterministic log-space]
\lean{Complexity.coNL}
\label{Complexity.coNL}
\leanok
\uses{Complexity.NL}
The class $	ext{coNL}$ consists of all languages over the Boolean alphabet whose
complements belong to the class of languages decidable in nondeterministic logarithmic
space.
\end{definition}

\begin{theorem}[Polynomial space inclusion]
\lean{Complexity.space_poly_subset_PSPACE}
\label{Complexity.space_poly_subset_PSPACE}
\leanok
\uses{Complexity.PSPACE, Complexity.SPACE}
\difficulty{1}
For every natural number $c$, every language decidable by a finite Turing machine using
at most a constant multiple of $n^c+1$ work-tape cells on inputs of length $n$ belongs
to $	ext{PSPACE}$.
\end{theorem}

\begin{theorem}[Polynomial space is contained in nondeterministic polynomial space]
\lean{Complexity.PSPACE_subset_NPSPACE}
\label{Complexity.PSPACE_subset_NPSPACE}
\leanok
\uses{Complexity.NPSPACE, Complexity.PSPACE, Complexity.SPACE_subset_NSPACE}
\difficulty{1}
Every language decidable by a deterministic finite Turing machine using at most
$c(n^d+1)$ work-tape cells, for some natural numbers $c,d$, is also decidable by a
nondeterministic finite Turing machine using at most $C(n^D+1)$ work-tape cells, for
some natural numbers $C,D$. The nondeterministic machine halts within some finite number
of steps on every branch for each input.
\end{theorem}

\begin{theorem}[Log space is contained in nondeterministic log space]
\lean{Complexity.LOGSPACE_subset_NL}
\label{Complexity.LOGSPACE_subset_NL}
\leanok
\uses{Complexity.LOGSPACE, Complexity.NL, Complexity.SPACE_subset_NSPACE, Complexity.logSpace}
\difficulty{1}
Every language decidable by a finite Turing machine using space bounded by a constant
multiple of $\log_2(n)+1$ is decidable by a finite nondeterministic Turing machine using
space bounded by a constant multiple of $\log_2(n)+1$.
\end{theorem}
